title: José V12 · reparar fixture V11 inmutable antes del browser gate
mission: Repará o reemplazá de forma explícita la selección de la fixture V11 inmutable usada por .github/workflows/jose-v12-runtime-verification.yml para que la preparación estricta base64 -> gzip -> sha256 pase sin debilitar los gates. Conservá la identidad del candidato V12 y el digest esperado de la fixture. Después ejecutá el workflow canónico y verificá que alcance la etapa Chromium/map/toggle. No modifiques ni promociones product bytes, Catalog, Current, Human Accepted o Served.
definition_of_done: La fixture V11 seleccionada por el workflow pasa base64.b64decode(validate=True), gzip.decompress y el digest SHA-256 esperado sin relajar ninguna comprobación.
El gate de identidad del candidato V12 continúa exigiendo blob 8f22dd9e0079dab7174eaba784a0d6c793e0ac90 o documenta un cambio de baseline explícito con evidencia en vez de saltearlo.
El workflow canónico progresa más allá de Prepare immutable V11 fixture y alcanza la ejecución Chromium de mapa/toggle, registrando su resultado real.
No se mutan/promueven Current, Catalog, Human Accepted, Served ni product bytes como efecto de esta reparación.
allowed_scope: coordination/workstreams/jose-study-design-20260911/material/PROMETEO_JOSE_RECOVERY_ENGINE_V11.html.gz.b64 only when an evidence-backed immutable fixture repair is required
bounded verification receipts/tests directly required to prove fixture and workflow behavior
forbidden_scope: weakening/removing base64 gzip sha256 or candidate-blob identity gates

semantic_identity.problem: pinned immutable v11 fixture fails strict whitespace-normalized base64 decoding before browser verification can start
acceptance: no current human accepted served or product-byte promotion occurs during fixture repair and verification
runtime verification reaches chromium map and toggle execution after the fixture gate
workflow prepares a valid immutable v11 fixture under strict base64 decode without weakening candidate blob or fixture digest gates

truth_boundary: Fixture/workflow repair only. This does not prove the browser verification passes and grants no promotion authority.
